title: DeepSeek stream inspector
focus: A chunk is not a sentence.
description: Separate model-provided trace from the final answer without losing data at streaming boundaries.
lesson: The upstream two-pass parser assumes think tags align with chunks and can drop answer text following a closing tag in the same chunk. The incremental parser retains partial delimiters and preserves the entire final answer.
experiment: Replay a trace and final answer with the closing tag split at every character boundary. Compare the assembled answer with the unsplit reference, then test a real arithmetic answer separately.
starter: A notebook costs 37 rupees and a pen costs 19 rupees. What is the total for three notebooks and two pens? Give the final total clearly.
pitfall: The displayed trace is generated model output, not a correctness proof. Stream segmentation must not change the final answer.
